title: One overview of a personal garage
description: Cars and other machines have separate logs, while the upcoming work is visible together.

blocks.text: An owner of several items needs order without complicated fleet management. Different kinds of machine differ in how they are measured and serviced.

quote.text: I have a generator, an RV, 3 motorcycles, and a truck. I like the app and have had it for several years. I do not understand why the developers have chosen not to provide a plan where the number of personal vehicles cannot be increased.

blocks.text: Give every item its own units, documents and intervals. Show only the selected upcoming actions in the shared overview.
Start with a few kinds of machine that are genuinely supported. A universal form built around car mileage does not fit engine hours and seasonal work.
